capacity: At most8192 entries under existing Pin/Text grammars. Bound full canonical UTF8 escaped bytes and all ordered distinct-roster membership work, actual table write/readback/positive EOF request, source/qualification/environment reads, retained lookup+raw captures, and every repeated downstream reader. Existing complete plan/source caps and original H/parent shares apply; a large valid structural table may be physically infeasible and must refuse, not chunk/truncate/drop tools.
command_inverse: Each command is exactly one original qualified executable/wrapper argv element in the actual selected mounted environment. Preserve bytes/text; no whitespace/shell splitting, shell expansion, PATH search, filesystem joining or inputs.root/tool.path/output_root reconstruction. If the old qualification only has a shell string/relative unresolved name, this route refuses until an exact earlier qualified single-element binding exists. No numerical/scientific method/tool behavior changes.

consumers.assembly: ProgrammeSeal/capture manifest/receipts keep original policy lineage; actual ProgrammeAssembly consumes same table and rechecks every argv value, report-source/argument ordinals, full candidate job roster, source/inherited projections and original dispatcher/assembler provenance.
consumers.development_contract: Complete typed table+versioned policy capture, actual private source/qualifier/environment lineage, exact ordered coverage and every cap before admitted return. Retain binding on same original ContractAdmissionHandle.
consumers.programme_capture: Both arms retain same earlier contract/policy/table. Every ProgrammeToolArgument at any argv ordinal resolves exact entry using its actual retained binding; argv[0] remains mandatory ProgrammeToolArgument. Source/inherited/literal branches unchanged. Each command is emitted exactly once at that declared position.
consumers.serialized_outer: ExecutionBinding/seal/output readers authenticate the exact earlier table through policy and original qualified source/root lineage, compare every projected argv element with declared typed argv. A matching table body is evidence, not a replacement live programme capture capability.

earlier_order: actual original root source-admission and tool qualification/environment owners
bind exact previous qualified tool-command pairs under same original parent before table effects
PublicTaskInterface/ProgrammeCaptureABI exposure and full original construction/admission
preparation and both original development arms
ProgrammeCapture typed argv projection and source/seals
failure: Missing actual qualifier/mapping/source/environment, stale policy, command mismatch, missing/duplicate/foreign tool, over-cap table or publication failure refuses before policy/arm dependent effects. Preserve raw first, all original attempted captures/reservations, known prefixes/unknown costs and independent once-cleanup; no retry, synthetic empty table, cap increase or method substitution.
no_cycle: Table has no policy, output ABI, preparation, arm, manifest, programme, seal, ExecutionBinding, receipt or self Pin. Its three parent Pins all refer to actual earlier completed source/qualification/environment products; schema validation cannot mint their live owner.

policy_migration.all_callers: Actual earlier selected original tool roster supplies the table before current NativeAgentPolicyV3. early issuer/static source selection, development_contract, preparation, root/native policy, PublicTaskInterface/output ABI admission, ProgrammeCapture, ProgrammeAssembly, programme_links_v3 and outer output_contract all select this same current native policy and exact earlier table.
policy_migration.base: Original AgentPolicy and NativeAgentPolicyV2 closed bodies remain exact historical/base identities. The single current native route uses NativeAgentPolicyV3 with all identical original native fields plus tool_commands. Current output/contract/preparation consumers explicitly select that same native policy; no second nonnative/table-free fallback is introduced.
policy_migration.native_policy: NativeContextPolicyV2 immutable predecessor fields remain exact predecessor references. Its new current native AgentPolicyV3 points to current policy and same table. No future current policy is inserted into table.

producer.capture: Same original ParentCustody and bounded original Store/CanonicalPublisher with actual source binding; one complete ordered table publication and exact readback under original input/output/member/depth/read/write/CPU/wall/retained limits. Actual CapturedRecord plus private qualifier identity produces QualifiedProgrammeToolBindingV1; parsed table cannot.
producer.constructor_join: The original admitted static input chain and DevelopmentContract receive the exact private binding from that same prior-root continuation, retain actual table_capture and qualifier/environment/source identities, then verify current policy.tool_commands equals that capture.pin. Register before effects and retain failed prefix.
producer.input_contract: Exact actual original qualified tool roster and ordered command bindings produced during the original source/environment qualification. For each selected tool, original qualifier retains actual authenticated source/executable or wrapper identity, exact mounted environment and complete previously qualified single-element executable command. Qualification relation binds source_admission, qualification product and environment and has no future current policy dependency.
producer.missing_mapping_data: If earlier real qualifier lacks command data, implement this fixed source-owned continuation at that original qualification site: observe/authenticate selected executable/wrapper and mounted environment under original root/native authority; retain exact single command used in that qualification with actual tool identity before emitting completion. It is not legal to accept an injected mapping/boolean or to derive command from Store/Pin.path. This design selects that concrete source contract; actual source/native qualification and completed earlier evidence remain required. No new tool qualification is performed in this authoring phase.
producer.source_entry: Fixed prior-root source-admission qualifier continuation produce_qualified_programme_tool_commands_v1; registered QualifiedToolCommandOwnerV1 before clock/read/validation/publication. Existing issuer_prerequisites.require_prior_static_owner remains actual upstream dependency, not a callable supplied by a user.

roster_inverse: Traverse selected policy.tool_closure in its declared order; choose first occurrence of each exact Pin identity. Entries must have exactly this ordered distinct roster, one each, no omissions/extras/reordering/duplicates. A repeated tool selection points to the same entry; it does not add another command. Empty tool_closure produces actual empty table only after real prior qualifier confirms it, not a missing-input default.
same_command: No uniqueness requirement on command string by itself; repeated command is permitted only where the original actual qualifier proves the same executable/wrapper binding for the exact selected tools. Equal text never establishes that proof.
scope: ProgrammeArgument/ProgrammeToolArgument and original102/output15 record bodies unchanged. Original266roles47APIs43owners65gates/all4 programmes unchanged; nominal source APIs added separately, no new scientific job or native execution.
